_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the player's ship (type 1, slot 0), corridor and shared part ($8C98-$8ED7). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: first frame?
regions.description: THE PLAYER'S SHIP (type 1, slot 0), bank 3 `$8C98`: reached from bank 6 `$846E` (type 1) through bank 3 slot `$8000`. Type bit 7 set goes to `$8CE7`. The object is slot 0; it is never given the table stats (`$CFA0`): this routine sets what it needs.

regions.name: init: initialised bit
regions.description: The type gets bit 7.

regions.name: init: picture phase
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`.

regions.name: init: attack
regions.description: `JSR $C132` (`$FD0E`): the attack level capped at 4 and `$05A8` from `$FD4B`.

regions.name: init, corridor: bank phase
regions.description: `$0680` := 5, the middle of the 0-10 banking phase.

regions.name: init, corridor: picture
regions.description: Metasprite 1.

regions.name: init, corridor: no foot offset, no tile base
init, labyrinth: foot offset
regions.description: `$06B0` := 8, the offset added to y for the cell probe of the move.

regions.name: init, labyrinth: set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`; Y := the pad cell `$32`; `JSR $8F85` sets the ship's picture.

regions.name: special state?
regions.description: `$07E8` non-zero (a scripted exit or entrance; bank 1)...

regions.name: special state: bank 1
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with the inline bytes `01 FF 7F`: a far call to bank 1 `$8000` (-> `$803C`: the scripted ship, which moves it and draws it itself).

regions.name: special state: return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: the pad cell
regions.description: `JSR $C02D` (`$DAE1`): in a demo the pad is overwritten with the canned patterns, and then `$32` := `$DB22[($F7 OR $F8) AND $0F]`: **`$32` = 3 x column + row, column 0 left / 1 / 2 right, row 0 down / 1 / 2 up; 4 is no direction, and opposite directions cancel.**

regions.name: corridor?
regions.description: `$30` bit 6 set goes to the corridor code at `$8D27`.

regions.name: labyrinth: exit pending?
regions.description: `$A0` bit 0 set (a room change is being asked for) skips the move and goes to the flash and the drawing.

regions.name: labyrinth: no direction?
regions.description: Pad cell 4.

regions.name: labyrinth, no direction: reset the animation
regions.description: `$0650` := `$FF`, so the walk animation restarts at its first pose; then the cell events if `$0728` is zero.

regions.name: labyrinth: facing and velocity
regions.description: `$0668` := `$8EF4[cell]` (the facing, 0-15); `JSR $C102`: the speed from the facing and the speed class `$0698`.

regions.name: labyrinth: move and cell events
regions.description: `JSR $8FB9` (below).

regions.name: labyrinth: on
regions.description: `JMP $8DF5`.

regions.name: corridor: hit spin?
regions.description: `$0578` bits 7 and 6 both set (hit and still flashing)...

regions.name: corridor, hit spin: picture phase
regions.description: `LDA #$80 / LDY #$0C / JSR $C0A5`: 12 phases, a new one every 2 frames.

regions.name: corridor, hit spin: metasprite
regions.description: `$0548` := `$8D44[phase]` (`01 02 03 04 05 06 07 06 05 04 03 02`): the ship rolls through its banked pictures.

regions.name: corridor, hit spin: on
regions.description: `JMP $8D9A`: it can still move.

regions.name: corridor: the banking phase, sideways
regions.description: Y := the pad cell; the sideways part `$8EEB[cell]` (-1, 0, +1) non-zero goes to `$8D76`.

regions.name: corridor: no sideways: back to the middle
regions.description: `$0680` steps one toward 5.

regions.name: corridor: the banked picture
regions.description: `$0548` := `$8EFD[$0680]` (`03 02 02 02 02 01 02 02 02 02 03`) and `$0560` := `$8F08[$0680]` (0 for 0-5, `$40` for 6-10: mirrored): RUN: moving left it banked 9 -> 0 in 9 frames, picture 2 then 3 (metasprites 1-3), moving right 10 with the mirror.

regions.name: corridor: facing
regions.description: `$0668` := `$8EF4[cell]`: `06 08 0A 04 0C 0C 02 00 0E` for the nine cells, i.e. down-left, left, up-left, down, (12 = up, unused), up, down-right, right, up-right. **With no direction the facing stays up (12), so the gun fires up.**

regions.name: corridor: no direction: no move
regions.description: Cell 4 skips the move.

regions.name: corridor: velocity
regions.description: `JSR $C102`: the speed from the facing and `$0698` (5 in the corridors: 2.3 px a frame, 1.65 on a diagonal).

regions.name: corridor: y
regions.description: y := y + the speed (and the fraction `$0758`), kept between `$18` and `$B0`; on a clamp the fraction is cleared. RUN: up stopped at y 24, down at 176.

regions.name: corridor: x
regions.description: x := x + the speed (and `$0770`), kept between `$0C` and `$F4`. RUN: left stopped at 12, right at 244.

regions.name: the picture to draw
regions.description: A := the metasprite `$0548`; **when the life shown `$49` is 0 the picture is `$0A` (the ship's death picture)**; `JSR $C0B4`.

regions.name: the gun: B held?
regions.description: `$F7 OR $F8` bit 6. Not held: `$33` := 1 (so the first frame of the next hold fires).

regions.name: the gun: delay
regions.description: `$33` is decremented; at zero it is reloaded from the shot delay `$39` (12 5 4 3 2 1 by the fire rate).

regions.name: the gun: a free slot
regions.description: The gun's slots are 1 to `$3B` (up to `$3B` shots alive: 3 in the run): the first with type 0.

regions.name: the gun: make a shot
regions.description: That slot gets type 2 at the ship's y and x, and the facing in its `$0788`. RUN: B held from frame 0: a shot every 4 frames, up to three alive, travelling at 7.5 px a frame upward (tier 2).

regions.name: the A weapon: selected and A pressed?
regions.description: `$3C` zero, or A (`$F7 OR $F8` bit 7) not held, skips.

regions.name: the A weapon: free slots
regions.description: From the first slot above the gun's (slot `$3B` + 1) up to slot 4: **every free slot gets a type-3 object** at the ship's place with the facing (so one slot for most weapons, two for Back Fire, Area Blaster and Cutter Laser). RUN: weapon 1 with A held put a single type 3 in slot 4 (`$3B` = 3).

regions.name: the hit flash
regions.description: `$0578` bit 7 clear skips to the drawing.

regions.name: the hit flash: count
regions.description: `$0788` is decremented (15 after a hit, set by the damage routine `$D2C5`); non-zero goes on to the blink.

regions.name: the hit flash: over
regions.description: At zero: in the labyrinth `JSR $8F89` restores the ship's picture; `$0578` AND `$3F` clears bits 7 and 6.

regions.name: the hit flash: blink
regions.description: Bit 6 set draws every frame; otherwise only on frames where `$0788` is even.

regions.name: corridor: the exhaust flame
regions.description: Y := (`$41` AND 2) / 2 plus 1, 2 or 3 more for the scroll speeds (`$B9`) of 1+, 3+ and 4+.

regions.name: the flame's tile base
regions.description: `$87` := `$8ED8[Y]` (`FF 00 30 32`); `$FF` (a negative) draws nothing, the others draw metasprite `$1D` through `$C093`.

regions.name: the hit overlay
regions.description: `$0578` bit 6 set (just hit): Y := the flash count; `$8EDC[Y]` zero returns.

regions.name: the hit overlay: draw
regions.description: Palette from the ship, tile base `$70`, metasprite `$21` through `$C093`: a flash piece over the ship on the frames the table `$8EDC` (`34 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 01 00 01 00 01 00 01`) is non-zero.

regions.name: return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: Hit overlay flash by remaining count (15 entries)
Sideways part of the pad cell
regions.description: `FF FF FF 00 00 00 01 01 01`: -1 for the left column, 0, +1 for the right.

regions.name: Corridor ship metasprite by banking phase
Corridor ship palette by banking phase
